m13.text: Chronomaton is the clockwork creation that Bazzle wakes to find has escaped again, and he finds strange keys, hundreds of them, left in his shop.

He finds a crude brass clockwork arm made of melted keys and realizes the creature has learned its creator's trade and become his apprentice, but when he tries to dislodge its chest key it winds itself and strikes him in the face.
On the third morning Bazzle finds his good arm severed and the metal arm attached in its place, and he realizes the creature never wanted a companion, only to stop sharing a body with him.
The creature takes a cleaver and beheads Bazzle, setting its own head in his place and completing itself.
